StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT /*poc:heavy*/ x.region, x.order_id, x.amount FROM (SELECT c.region, o.order_id, o.amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.note DESC, o.amount) AS rn FROM dbo.orders o JOIN dbo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.amount > 10) x WHERE x.rn % 100000 = 0 OPTION (MAXDOP 4, MAX_GRANT_PERCENT = 1)
